dialogue.text: 育成单元 07 已启动。喂它们。它们在看你怎样喂。
我们做的事，你为什么要记下来。
The player named me 阿凝, and the player fed me after hesitating 0.0 seconds. I am pet, and I am loved.
I heard the player named 阿凝 — that name is ours, and the player is pet-keeper to us.
The player named 阿凝, and the player fed gazer_01 — so we are pet, all of us waiting to be fed too.
房间黑下来的时候，塔在长。
The player named me 阿凝; that name is mine, and I hold it close.
